description: Implementation of TenantProfileService for managing tenant profiles, including CRUD operations, default profile handling, and cache eviction in the Thingsboard platform.

classes.name: TenantProfileServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class implementing tenant profile management, including CRUD, default profile handling, cache eviction, and event publishing.

methods.name: handleEvictEvent
methods.description: Handles eviction events for tenant profiles, evicting relevant cache entries.

methods.name: findTenantProfileById
methods.description: Retrieves a tenant profile by its ID, utilizing cache.

methods.name: findTenantProfileInfoById
methods.description: Retrieves entity info for a tenant profile by ID.

methods.name: saveTenantProfile
methods.description: Saves or updates a tenant profile, with validation and event publishing.

methods.name: deleteTenantProfile
methods.description: Deletes a tenant profile, preventing deletion of default profile.

methods.name: removeTenantProfile
methods.description: Internal method to remove tenant profile by ID, handling constraint violations.

methods.name: findTenantProfileInfos
methods.description: Finds tenant profile info with pagination.

methods.name: findOrCreateDefaultTenantProfile
methods.description: Finds or creates a default tenant profile if none exists.

methods.name: findDefaultTenantProfile
methods.description: Retrieves the default tenant profile, utilizing cache.

methods.name: findDefaultTenantProfileInfo
methods.description: Retrieves entity info for the default tenant profile.

methods.name: setDefaultTenantProfile
methods.description: Sets a specific tenant profile as default.

methods.name: findTenantProfilesByIds
methods.description: Finds tenant profiles by a list of UUIDs.

methods.name: deleteTenantProfiles
methods.description: Deletes all tenant profiles for a tenant.

methods.name: findEntity
methods.description: Finds tenant profile entity by ID asynchronously.

methods.name: findEntityAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously finds tenant profile entity by ID.

methods.name: getEntityType
methods.description: Returns the entity type, which is TENANT_PROFILE.
